vfx_hit.png:
A single game visual effect sprite, drawn as flat cartoon art with thick black outlines.

Effect: a comic-book impact burst - a jagged white and yellow starburst with a few short speed lines shooting outward, the classic "POW" shape without any text

It will be layered over characters in a cartoon roguelike, shown about 120 pixels wide. Bold and readable at that size:
strong simple shape, high contrast, no fine detail, no gradient haze.
Draw it SOLID and OPAQUE - filled in with flat bright colour. Do NOT make it transparent, translucent,
glassy or see-through, and do not fade it out at the edges.
Nothing else in the picture: no character, no ground, no shadow, no text, no letters, no watermark, no border.
Background must be a solid pure green (#00FF00), completely flat, for chroma keying.
Output 768x768 PNG. Save the image as vfx_hit.png in the current directory and report the path.
